validation_boundary: Atoms were validated against a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from recent validated project LiteratureAtom artifacts and the large-source guideline guardrail. Because the authoritative ATOM model/schema files were not directly retrievable, this report does not claim execution of the governing project Pydantic/schema code.

consistency_review.finding: Recommendation strength/certainty are preserved in tags; Practice Points are explicitly ungraded. Chapters 9/10 are marked outdated by the source and therefore are not emitted as active formal-guidance atoms. Underlying study results remain secondary-source evidence and are not promoted to primary-study atoms.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom pattern used in project outputs has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or practice_point atom kind. Formal guideline statements are serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.
The schema has no native field for guideline-version deprecation/supersession by an external update; source-level deprecation is preserved through dedicated other atoms and tags.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements were normalized from the PDF text layer to repair line-wrap hyphenation, ligatures, inequality symbols, and fused figure citation markers.
All atoms remain needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model without independent human verification.
The data supplement was used for SEA evidence reconciliation and reference extraction; individual evidence-profile rows were not converted to primary-study atoms.

The supplied file name references 2024 chapter updates, but the file content is the 2021 guideline with warnings that Chapters 9 and 10 are outdated; the replacement 2024 chapters are not present in the supplied package.
